body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/ROCm/FlyDSL/issues/717

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/FlyDSL/issues/701

This starts from the exact PR698 candidate (`8f8d9aaffdcf57ce573a96609134690f24639f31`) and preserves its opt-in SwiGLU-OAI implementation and packed-A4 tests.

The BM16 inline failure was reproduced on the actual MI350X/gfx950 kernel at normalized error 0.007878099790699977 (threshold 0.002). The first mismatch was in the test contract: the inline kernel consumes BF16 hidden states, but the reference quantized the pre-cast FP32 generator tensor. The narrow repair quantizes the exact BF16 values in the independent MXFP4/FP32 reference; it does not alter kernel code or tolerances. The deterministic regression then measured 0.001035 and passed.

Validation includes a committed standalone probe with raw FP4 bytes, E8M0 scales and dequantized values for exact values, ties, signed zero, zero blocks, extreme dynamic range and padding. Exact MiniMax dimensions were exercised for both ordinary SiLU and SwiGLU-OAI at 1/2/4/16/32/256 tokens, hidden 6144, intermediate 3072, 128 routed experts, top-k4, plus a separate one-expert shared projection. Logs identify BM16 inline and preserved BM32 packed dispatches and contain independent FP32-reference results.

Reproduce:

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-27a00da88ece/venv/bin/python reports/j-27a00da88ece/probe_inline_quant.py
FLYDSL_RUN_MINIMAX_M3_SHAPE=1 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-27a00da88ece/venv/bin/python -m pytest 'tests/kernels/test_moe_gemm.py::test_minimax_m3_a4w4_model_shape[inline-silu]' 'tests/kernels/test_moe_gemm.py::test_minimax_m3_a4w4_model_shape[inline-swigluoai]' -vv -s
```

No C++ changed, so no native rebuild was required. BM64 interleaved remains explicitly xfailed. Full-model inference, multi-rank EP, the packed-path EP valid mask, and serving integration remain unverified; this PR does not claim automatic AITER or SGLang adoption. Complete commands, raw results, device/compiler/import paths, and limitations are under `reports/j-27a00da88ece/`.
